ON 14MAY11, THE 74.8 FT. INSPECTED PASSENGER VESSEL LU-LU BELL IS HARD AGROUND IN PORT ETCHES NEAR ENGLISH BAY ON THE WESTERN SIDE OF HINCHINBROOK ISLAND. VESSEL GROUNDED WHEN THE VESSEL MASTER FELL ASLEEP AFTER GULF OF ALASKA TRANSIT FROM ELFIN COVE. VESSEL HAD ENTERED PORT ETCHES TO REST PRIOR TO CONTINUING TO VALDEZ FOR THE SUMMER PASSENGER VESSEL SEASON. THE TWO POB O/B AT TIME OF GROUNDING WERE REMOVED VIA CG-6014 WITH NO INJURIES.
